title: Accidental Emergency Slide Deployment Delays Trump's Departure From Washington
snippet: Donald Trump's departure from Washington faced an unexpected mishap when an emergency slide accidentally deployed on his Qatar-gifted aircraft at Joint Base Andrews.
content:
WASHINGTON — Former President Donald Trump experienced an unusual tarmac delay on Tuesday when an emergency evacuation slide unexpectedly deployed from his aircraft shortly before departure.

Tarmac Mishap at Joint Base Andrews

The incident occurred as ground crews prepared the luxury Boeing 747—a lavish jet gifted to him by the Qatari royal family—for a flight out of the nation's capital. Personnel on the tarmac were caught off guard as the bright yellow inflatable slide deployed from one of the jet's exit doors, forcing a temporary halt to pre-flight operations.

Quick Resolution and Departure

Ground staff and maintenance technicians acted quickly to remove the deployed slide and conduct standard safety inspections. A spokesperson confirmed that no injuries occurred during the accidental deployment, describing the event as a minor technical glitch.

Following a brief delay to ensure the aircraft met all safety protocol requirements, Trump and his team departed Washington without further incident.
